Procurement Administration
Master data & governance for the Procurement app — administered here, alongside access & permissions.
System Integrations
Microsoft 365, approval email, SharePoint & the Procurement launcher. Admin only — these control where data is sent.
When set, approval notifications also post to your Teams channel. Teams → channel → Connectors → Incoming Webhook.
Paste the SharePoint folder link where payment / claim / travel files should be stored. On submit the file uploads here and the SharePoint link is shown to the requester and approver (like the project document folders). Files are filed by the SERVER on submit into <Payments|Claims|Travel>/<year>/<month>/<reference>/, so it works whether or not anyone is signed in to Microsoft. Leave blank to keep files inside the portal.
Paste the SharePoint folder link for HR documents. Job Descriptions attached to a requisition are filed by the SERVER into JD/<year>/, so it works whether or not anyone is signed in to Microsoft. Leave blank and JDs stay inside the portal, and signed policy acknowledgements stay in the portal too.
Editor and Admin can already publish. Naming somebody here adds to that — use it for the HR officer who writes the policies, so she gets + Publish a document and the Edit / Re-issue / Archive controls without being promoted to Editor. Several addresses may be listed, separated by commas. A department manager still cannot publish: committing every employee to signing something is not something you inherit by running a department. Leave blank and it falls back to “Approver (Management) or above”.
Reconstructs each employee's dated salary, grade, title and department history from the pay runs a Director has signed. Rows somebody recorded by hand are never touched — only the reconstruction is rebuilt, and what it removes is written to the audit trail. Safe to run more than once. Run this if the portal's employment history was ever built by an earlier version, which read the payslip total as salary.
Labour Code Art. 107 allows 200 hours a year, and 300 only for the industries Art. 107(3) lists, after notifying the labour authority. Leave blank for 200 — the answer for any company that has not taken and recorded that decision. The daily (4h) and monthly (40h) limits are fixed by the article and are not editable. Approving beyond a limit is still possible, but only with a reason, and it is written into the audit trail under the approver's name.
At or above this total, a quotation cannot be issued — no PDF, no Excel workbook — until somebody electronically signs it, the same Part 11 signature used for a pay run. Leave blank to turn it off. Most quotations are routine, and a control that fires on every one of them is one people learn to route around. The signature is tied to the total it was given for: if the price then changes, the signature stops counting and a fresh one is needed — otherwise a real name and a real timestamp end up standing behind a number nobody approved.
Every Vietnamese bank publishes its own upload template. Set the columns your bank expects and in what order — changing bank is a setting here, not a new release. Download a sample file from your bank's portal (Techcombank F@st EBank: Payroll → Bulk transfer → Download template) and copy its headings exactly; the bank matches on the heading text. Leave it untouched to use the shipped layout.
When on (recommended), the person who releases a payment must not be the one who gave final approval — and no one can pay their own request. This needs at least two authorised payers. Turn OFF only if your finance function is a single person; paying your own request stays blocked either way.
Releasing money is a named duty, not something everyone with an access level inherits. Only these people see Mark paid. Being listed is the grant, so a payer does not need Editor/Admin — but they do need access to the Finance page. Leave blank to fall back to “any Editor or Admin”. The rules above still apply on top: never your own request, and never one you approved.
A named duty, never a level: “who may read a harassment report” is a decision about individuals, not something inherited by running a department. The Client Audit Pack asks for this explicitly and has been reporting it unanswered — the setting existed and there was no field to fill it, so every concern fell back to whoever happened to be an HR admin. List several, separated by commas. Admin only.
The region of the workplace, used as the default when an employee record does not name their own. Until this is set the Minimum-Wage Register can check nobody and reports every employee as unchecked — it says so rather than passing them silently. This is a statutory figure: set it to the region your site actually sits in. Admin only.
Emails the reviewer, approver and requester at every step of the approval flow (submit → review → approve / reject / paid). Decisions are still made in the portal with an e‑signature — the email carries a secure “Review in portal” button, never a one‑click approve link. Requires Microsoft 365 Mail.Send application consent on the Humiley app.
Remind after day(s) waiting, then once a day.
Escalate after day(s) overdue (0 = off) → CC on the nudge.
Once a week, each manager gets what’s awaiting their review; leadership gets a company‑wide roll‑up (pending · overdue · total value). Uses the same Mail.Send as above.
Send every · Leadership email
On the chosen day each month, emails leadership a branded summary of the closed month (payments, invoices & VAT, approvals, headcount) with a link to open & export the full pack in the portal.
Send on day · To
On working days, pushes a reminder to any active employee who hasn't checked in by the check-in time, and to anyone still checked in at the check-out time. Skips weekends, holidays & staff on leave. Uses Web Push (not email).
Check-in reminder at :00 · Check-out reminder at :00
Verify each go‑live switch‑on actually worked — Microsoft 365, invoice sync, approval email, SharePoint, push.
Where the Procurement Portal is served — an app of this portal at portal.humiley.com/procurement. The sidebar entry opens it (no second login) for every employee an admin has granted the Procurement app in Access & Permissions. Leave blank to use the default (localhost:3000/procurement in development).

Resources & Quick Links
Our Library (board tiles)
The tiles on the Library page. Paste the SharePoint or intranet address for each. Leave the address blank and the tile still shows, marked as needing a link — view:wiki and view:knowledge open this portal's own Wiki and Knowledge Hub pages.
Library locations (SharePoint)
Where the Company Wiki and Knowledge Hub pages read from. Files are listed with each reader's own SharePoint permissions and are never copied into the portal, so changing these widens nobody's access.
The wiki page the company publishes in SharePoint. The Company Wiki page links straight to it.
Where the wiki's files live. Paste the site address to read its default document library, or a folder address to start inside that folder. Files are listed with each reader's own SharePoint permissions and are never copied into the portal, so this widens nobody's access.
The Knowledge Hub page on the Learning Management System site.
Where the knowledge-hub files live — same rules as the wiki library above.
Document bar — departments
The Documents bar already shows every department somebody is assigned to. Add a row here only for a department that has no employees yet — the name must match its folder in the library. Tick Board only on the department whose documents are for the Board: its tab is then hidden from everyone below Approver.

Hiding a tab is tidiness, not a lock. Those folders live in a library SharePoint already serves to everyone who can open it, so a hidden folder is still reachable by searching the library or opening SharePoint. To actually restrict the Board's documents, set permissions on that folder in SharePoint.
Department documents — exceptions
The Documents bar shows General plus one tab per department, and each department tab opens the folder of that name in the library. Add a row here only for a department whose documents live somewhere else — its own SharePoint site — and that address wins for that tab.
Wiki — pinned pages
Optional shortcuts shown under the wiki's documents — a SharePoint page or folder worth putting in front of everybody. The wiki's own contents come from SharePoint and need nothing here.

Add Work Schedule
The mid-shift break inside these hours. Art. 109 requires at least 30 consecutive minutes on a day of 6 hours or more, 45 where 3 or more hours fall between 22:00 and 06:00. It only counts as paid working time for continuous shift work (Decree 145 Art. 63(3)). Working-time compliance is measured after this comes off.

Optional — a small square image works best.
Compensation — 3P Salary (HML-CB-001)
Each registered dependant reduces taxable income by ₫4,400,000/month.
Pick a grade to load the band; salary must be set explicitly before an employee can be included in a pay run. Gross splits into P1/P2/P3 automatically. Dependants must be registered with the tax authority before the relief may be applied — record here only what has been accepted.
Access & Provisioning
Which days this person normally works. It decides their rest days, and therefore whether overtime on a given day is paid at 150% or the 200% rest-day rate — and it sets the threshold for a late arrival. Patterns are defined in HR Admin → Work Schedules. Left blank, they are treated as Mon–Fri with Saturday and Sunday as rest days.
Labour Code Art. 113(1). A classification the company makes against the MOLISA occupational list — it is not inferred from a job title, because two people with the same title can be on different duties. It also sets the health-check cadence to every 6 months instead of 12.
Decree 44/2016 Art. 24. Safety training is only required — and only chased — where a group is set. Leaving this blank asserts the training requirement for nobody.
Raises the annual-leave base to at least 14 days (Art. 113(1)(b)), as does being under 18 — which is taken from the date of birth.
Art. 20(2)(c) recognises exactly these four cases, who may be renewed on fixed terms indefinitely. Everyone else may be renewed once, after which the next contract must be indefinite. It records WHICH exemption applies, not merely that one does — that is the question an inspector asks.
Both are needed before this person can appear in a salary payment file — the file is refused outright rather than produced without them, because a file missing one row uploads cleanly and looks correct.
